speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 1
speaker_contributions.text: Hi, let's start our meeting.

speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 1
speaker_contributions.text: Today we need to discuss the progress of the Neo University website.

speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 1
speaker_contributions.text: Sure, I have completed the homepage design and most of the navigation section.

speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 1
speaker_contributions.text: That's good.

speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 1
speaker_contributions.text: Are all the pages connected properly?

speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 1
speaker_contributions.text: Not yet.

speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 1
speaker_contributions.text: The admission and contact pages are still under development.

speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 1
speaker_contributions.text: What is causing the delay?

speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 1
speaker_contributions.text: I am waiting for the updated admission information from the documentation team.

speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 2
speaker_contributions.text: Okay, I will contact them today and ask them to send the information by tomorrow.

speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 2
speaker_contributions.text: That would help.

speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 2
speaker_contributions.text: Once I receive it, I can complete the admission page.

speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 2
speaker_contributions.text: How much time will you need after receiving the information?

speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 2
speaker_contributions.text: Approximately two days.

speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 2
speaker_contributions.text: So can you finish both the admission and contact pages by Friday?

speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 2
speaker_contributions.text: Yes, I should be able to finish them by Friday evening.

speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 1
speaker_contributions.text: Great.

speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 1
speaker_contributions.text: We also need to test the website on mobile devices.

speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 1
speaker_contributions.text: I will handle the responsive testing after completing the pages.

speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 1
speaker_contributions.text: Perfect.

speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 1
speaker_contributions.text: I will review the completed website on Monday.

speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 1
speaker_contributions.text: Sounds good.

speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 1
speaker_contributions.text: I will send you the updated version by Friday evening.

speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 1
speaker_contributions.text: Alright.

speaker_contributions.speaker: Speaker 1
speaker_contributions.text: That's all for today.
